targets.query: from(bucket: "iot_bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "readings" and r.type == "temperature" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "iot_bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "readings" and r.type == "co2" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "iot_bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "readings" and r.type == "fire_risk" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "iot_bucket") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "readings" and r.type == "fire_alarm" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "max")
